The background features stadium walls with advertisements for 'momo' and 'Taiwan Mobile' below blue spectator seating. A fielder in a similar Sun Star jersey sprints toward the ball, scoops it up with his glove, and throws it to the first baseman. The runner in the black jersey dives headfirst toward the first base bag, but the first baseman catches the ball just before the runner's hand touches the bag. A field umpire in a light blue shirt signals 'out' by raising his arm. (3) The camera follows the pitcher, identified by the text '方昶詠' and number '58' on his back, as he walks away from the mound. This higher angle captures the pitch, the hit, and the subsequent hustle of the fielder and runner towards first base. The movement is fluid, showing the dynamic nature of the game. (5) A close-up shot shows the pitcher walking toward the camera; he is now wearing black sports sunglasses and a black cap, smiling broadly. A graphic logo for the '2025 Sun Star 20th Anniversary' appears as an overlay in the center-right of the screen. (6) The final phase shows a new batter in a black Rap Star jersey and a red helmet preparing at the plate. In the background, fans are visible behind the dugout fence. A mobile phone control center interface briefly slides into view from the top of the frame, indicating a screen recording.
